title: Phong Nha Cave in half a day
summary: One stop. From the Tourism Center, the boat down the Son River and into Phong Nha Cave takes about two and a half hours. The entrance does not include the boat. Leave Paradise Cave for another ticket.

stops.name: Phong Nha Cave
stops.note: About 2.5 hours from the Tourism Center. The 150,000 VND entrance does not include the 700,000 VND boat.
